card.name: Study-result phrasing before statistics
card.fires_on: Words just before a reported study finding or statistic, such as 'demonstrated that', 'involved more', or a confidence interval '95%' or 'p=0'. Also fires on a few odd spots inside drug names.

modes.label: Study finding lead-in
modes.description: Linking words after a study verb, right before the result is stated.

modes.label: Statistic notation
modes.description: Parts of a number or interval in trial results such as p-values and confidence intervals.

modes.label: Inside a brand name
modes.description: Partway through the brand name ENTRESTO in dosing text.
modes.example: Double the dose of ENT<<REST>>O after 2 to 4 weeks

card.writes: It pushes toward some odd Chinese and code tokens and away from phrases like 'according' and 'statistically', so the output effect is unclear.
card.plain: It lights up on the small words that lead into a study's numbers or findings, like 'demonstrated that' or a confidence interval.
